Name: Epic Zuuker

Description.name: Epic Zuuker
Description.description: Born to be wild... a Wild Bagpipe! The Epic Zuuker draws air in through the various spiracles found all over its body, just as the Wubbox drew inspiration from the musical life-form that flourishes in high-altitude environment. It's basically a living instrument... but then, aren't all Singing Monsters living instruments, if you really think about it?

Combinations to Breed: Zap The Eggs Needed To Fill Epic Zuuker
